name: System Audit
description: Provides system-level audit capabilities across security, performance, and compliance.

capabilities.name: System Audit
capabilities.description: Perfom a basic system audit: lint, security, typecheck. Returns a markdown report.
promptGuidelines: Use system.audit to check lint, typecheck, and security audit.

capabilities.name: System Metrics
capabilities.description: Collects and returns system-level metrics (codebase metrics, performance stats).
promptGuidelines: Use system.metrics to get codebase metrics (lines, functions, complexity).

capabilities.name: System Health Check
capabilities.description: Performs basic health checks: Node.js runtime, memory usage, uptime. Returns JSON status.
promptGuidelines: Use system.health to check system health status.
